target_candidate.pmt_type: Hamamatsu R14374 3-inch (WCSim PMT3inchR14374_WCTE); LUCiD geometry sensor_radius 0.04 m, 105 mPMT modules x 19 PMTs

stage_owners.charge_gain: readout: one tabulated SPE charge per photoelectron (WCSim Getqpe/rn1pe distribution, mean normalised to 1 PE), summed per PMT, then the per-module gain
stage_owners.timing_width: readout Gaussian digit kernel, sigma(Q) = sqrt(1.5^2 + R(min(Q,4))^2)/2.355 ns (WCSim HitTimeSmearing, R spline-interpolated as TGraph::Eval(Q,0,"S")), evaluated at the digitised charge Q with no 0.5 PE floor (author decision 3 Nov 2026; WCSim's SKI digitizer passes max(Q, 0.5), recorded, not applied), with a per-module factor multiplying sigma; upstream TTS forbidden
stage_owners.dark_counts: readout (R-6): keyed Poisson dark photoelectrons per PMT, uniform in readout_window_ns, bypass QE/CE, then the same tabulated SPE charge, gain, discriminator, T-Q walk and width

transport.spectrum: fixture: uniform 300..600 nm synthetic, not Cherenkov; LUCiD pilots: PhotonSim Cherenkov photons in the 200..800 nm QE band

conventions.gain: dimensionless multiplier after PE detection and SPE smearing
conventions.timing: forward ns; D-TQ walk(q)=a+b/sqrt(min(q,q_sat)) on the charge domain; frozen reference subtraction; digit width is a symmetric Gaussian about photon arrival + walk with sigma(Q) = sqrt(1.5^2 + R(min(Q,4))^2)/2.355 ns, R the WCSim 14-point FWHM table interpolated with a not-a-knot cubic spline (ROOT TSpline3 without end conditions, as TGraph::Eval(Q,0,"S")); mean shift 0; digits earlier than photon arrival counted as digits_before_arrival
conventions.boundaries: charge above charge_domain_pe upper bound clamped to it and counted (overflow_clamped); charge below the domain or wavelength outside the QE table rejected; no extrapolation
conventions.rng: BLAKE2b pmt-v1 keyed by seed/event/persistent photon ID for detection, seed/event/persistent photon ID for the source-PE SPE charge (spe_charge), seed/event/(channel, rank) for the dark-PE SPE charge (dark_spe_charge), seed/event/channel for timing and dark counts, and seed/event/(channel, rank) for dark times; dark-noise-only windows add a dark_window:<n> stream namespace
conventions.discriminator: T-Q mode: continuous PE peak, hard threshold .25 PE applied to the digitised (SPE-smeared, gain-scaled) charge (author, R-7 v2 item 6); WCSim's SKI digitizer instead accepts with a probabilistic turn-on (recorded, not applied); legacy threshold_walk mode retains sampled-template normalization
conventions.per_channel_factors: factor_i = base + odd_group_delta * (group_i mod 2); group = dense mPMT module index on WCTE (D-G), contiguous 12-channel synthetic groups on the fixture
conventions.dark_counts: dark PE join the detected PE before digitisation; one digit per PMT, so a dark PE earlier than the source light sets that digit's time; n_dark_true is evaluation-only truth; dark-noise-only windows use noise_module_lucid.readout.dark_noise_window(params, n_channels, seed=, run=, window=)
conventions.charge: q_PMT = sum over its photoelectrons of x_k, x_k drawn from the WCSim Getqpe table: bin i with probability cdf[i]-cdf[i-1], uniform inside the bin, raw charge (i-50+u)/22.83 (WCSim rn1pe), divided by the table mean 1.064800 so the mean SPE charge is 1 PE; clipped at 0; then gain

fixture.geometry: synthetic 76-sensor cylinder toy.cylinder_detector(4, 12, 2), NOT WCTE geometry
fixture.group_source: contiguous fixture channels; NOT physical crates
fixture.photons_note: v1 declared 4000; cut to 1000 in prompt_run_02 only to fit the old 100 PE domain; restored under D-Q

adopted.timing_width: HitTimeSmearing: pmt_tts = 1.5 ns FWHM; 14-point resol table (constructor); Q clamped at 4 PE; Eval(Q,0,"S"); /2.355
adopted.qe_curve: GetQEWavelength/GetQE: 21 points 300-700 nm, raw values (the 1/0.73 correctionFactor not applied); zero outside 300-700 nm as the author instructs (edges at 299.99 and 700.01 nm; v2 domain anchors 200 and 800 nm kept)
adopted.spe_charge: Getqpe: 500-value cumulative table (trailing dummy dropped), sampled as rn1pe does, mean divided out

recorded_not_applied.qe_correction_factor: 1/0.73 (WCSim: July 2015 workaround, PR #98, 'will be removed'); open question for Junjie
recorded_not_applied.qe_method_ratio: WCTE.mac sets /WCSim/PMTQEMethod SensitiveDetector_Only (method 3); WCSimWCSD.cc then calls GetPMTQE with ratio = 1/(1-0.25), which multiplies QE, so WCSim's effective WCTE QE is raw x 1/0.73 x 4/3 (peak 0.492); not applied; open question for Junjie
recorded_not_applied.qe_outside_table: WCSimPMTQE.cc GetPMTQE (flag 1) returns 0 only at <= 200 nm or >= 660 nm; between 200 and 300 nm it extends the 300-320 nm segment linearly (QE 0.026 at 290 nm, positive down to 285.0 nm, negative and so in effect 0 below), and it cuts at 660 nm inside the table; not applied: the author asks for zero outside 300-700 nm

digitizer_ski.threshold: WCSimWCDigitizerSKI::Threshold: probabilistic turn-on polynomial in pe+0.1 (about 54% acceptance at 0.25 PE, 100% at >= 1.0 PE); with this Getqpe table about 6.9% of 1-PE hits are lost, against 2.96% for the hard 0.25 PE cut adopted here
digitizer_ski.timing_charge_floor_pe: HitTimeSmearing is called with Q = max(q, 0.5), so WCSim's digit sigma is flat at 0.670 ns below 0.5 PE; here sigma follows q down to 0.25 PE (0.760 ns), per the author's 3 Nov 2026 decision

GetNbOfQEDefined.reading: WCSimPMTQE.cc loops i < n and reads wavelength[i+1] ('off by one bug fix'), so n counts intervals and all 21 points are used; no point is dropped

spe_fit_record.form: w*Exp(tau) + (1-w)*Normal(mu, sigma) (Bellamy 1994), fitted to the table CDF at bin upper edges
spe_fit_record.ks_objective_note: the KS value depends on the fit objective: this is a least-squares fit to the CDF; a fit minimising the KS distance directly reaches 0.024, still above the tolerance
spe_fit_record.tolerance_provenance: 0.02 was fixed before any fit in the 23-25 Oct WCSim extraction script (_patches/pmt_r7v2/extract_v3.py, KS_TOL = 0.02, outside the repository)

author_decisions_3_nov_2026.spe: sample the WCSim 501-point table directly; do not fit
author_decisions_3_nov_2026.sigma_at_0.25pe: take WCSim's spline value 0.760 ns, not 0.77

wcte_fork_differences.class: PMT3inchR14374 (no PMT3inchR14374_WCTE class on any branch). Main WCSim c5ed0b1 also contains this same plain PMT3inchR14374 class; WCTE.mac selects PMT3inchR14374_WCTE (/WCSim/mPMT/PMTtype_inner), while WCSimDetectorConfigs.cc defaults mPMTs to the plain class, so the real difference is _WCTE vs plain class, not main vs fork
wcte_fork_differences.timing: constant Gaussian sigma 0.6 ns at every charge (B. Quilain: TTS 1.4 ns at 1 PE), no charge dependence
wcte_fork_differences.spe_table: different Getqpe table: raw mean 1.0197 PE, relative sigma 0.433 (main WCSim: 1.0648, 0.4525); max |dCDF| 0.069
wcte_fork_differences.identical: QE table and 1/0.73 factor, CE 95%, dark rate 1 kHz, GetNbOfQEDefined 20

cross_check.content: first R-7: Xia (2019) 20-inch proxies, split-normal Eq. 6.3, HK R12860 QE, CE 0.87, spe_sigma 0.30; never used by a result
